## Binary-Ours 代码审计结果 — 确认定义不一致

### 代码实现（ground truth）
Binary-ours 是 **(a) human vs ALL-synthetic soft weighting**：
- 二分类器: depth=0 (human, label=0) vs depth≥1 (ALL synthetic, label=1)
- 权重: `w = 1 - P(synthetic)` = P(human)
- 使用 `WeightedRandomSampler` 按权重采样

各 depth 的实际效果：
| Depth | P(synthetic) | w = P(human) | 效果 |
|-------|-------------|-------------|------|
| 0 (human) | ~0.05 | **~0.95** | 几乎满权重 |
| 1 (gen-1) | ~0.7-0.9 | **~0.1-0.3** | 大幅降权 |
| 2+ (gen-2~5) | ~0.95+ | **~0.05** | 近乎剔除 |

### 不一致点
- ✅ `experiments_c3.tex` L25-26: **正确** — "human (depth=0) vs synthetic (depth≥1), w = 1 - P(synthetic)"
- ✅ `discussion.tex` L182: **正确** — "retaining human-authored text while downweighting synthetic text (depth≥1)"
- ❌ `introduction.tex` L54: **错误** — "binary filtering at the K*=2 boundary—retaining depth-1 text while removing depth≥2"
  - 代码中 depth-1 被大幅降权（w~0.1-0.3），并非 "retained"
  - Binary-ours 操作在 human/synthetic 边界（K*=1），不是 K*=2 边界

### 概念澄清
K*=2 的意义不是 binary-ours 的工作边界，而是 **为什么 binary 就够了的解释**：
- K*=2 说明 depth-1 和 depth-2+ 不可分 → graduated 无法利用更细信息 → binary 已是最优
- Binary-ours 本身在 depth-0 vs depth≥1 的边界操作

从：
> "binary filtering at the K*=2 boundary—retaining depth-1 text while removing depth≥2"

改为类似：
> "binary filtering that downweights all synthetic text (depth≥1) relative to human-authored text—the only reliably discriminable boundary—is sufficient for effective data curation, matching or exceeding more granular approaches"

tool_args.title: 📄 论文草稿 — Abstract
tool_args.body:
Web-scale text corpora are increasingly contaminated by recursive synthetic content—text recursively generated across multiple generations, with recent estimates suggesting that 10–40% of content on some platforms is machine-generated. Information degrades monotonically per the Data Processing Inequality with each generation, yet no method estimates a document's generational depth.

We introduce the first systematic framework for generational depth estimation. Our approach extracts 15 statistical features and classifies depth via Ordinal Binary Decomposition (OBD) with LightGBM, preserving ordinal structure. We empirically measure the discrimination boundary K*, the maximum depth at which adjacent generations remain statistically distinguishable.

Across 4 model-mode configurations and 4 decoding strategies (8 conditions total) at the ≤1.5B parameter scale, we find K*=2 is consistent. Cross-model transfer shows classifiers retain 80–92% accuracy across continuation-mode generators, with binary (0-vs-1) AUC exceeding 0.96, indicating depth features are largely text-intrinsic. Preliminary neural probing yields K*_neural=3, suggesting our 15-feature K*=2 is a representation-dependent lower bound. Frontier LLMs achieve ~88% binary detection but only ~33% five-class depth accuracy—below our OBD classifier's 38.6%.

Our findings motivate a three-tier taxonomy (human / generation-1 / generation-2+) for depth-aware data curation; K*=2 correctly predicts that graduated refinement beyond the binary boundary provides no additional benefit—binary filtering at the K* boundary (0.5941 MMLU) outperforms both graduated depth weighting and surprisal-based selection (0.5894).

tool_args.title: 📄 论文草稿 — Introduction（摘要）
tool_args.body:
【问题】Web 文本被多代递归合成文本污染。当前方法只做 binary（人/机），不估计代际深度。

【Gap】Binary 检测器（DivEye, Min-K%++）无深度估计；Model collapse 文献描述宏观现象但不提供检测工具；数据选择方法（DSIR, D4, DoReMi）做分布匹配但不估计递归深度。Drayson et al. 最接近但仍是 binary。

【贡献 1 — K* Characterization（主贡献）】
(a) K*=2 在全部 8 条件下一致（4 model-mode + 4 decoding）
(b) 跨模型迁移保留 80-92% 准确率（Pythia↔OLMo: 90-92%）
(c) 特征退化排序一致性（Spearman ρ≥0.85）
(d) 生成模式分析：continuation 是 canonical condition

【贡献 2 — 实用验证（次要贡献）】
Binary soft weighting（human vs all synthetic）是唯一可靠可分的边界，已足够匹配或超过更细粒度方法。K*=2 意味着 depth≥2 不可分，graduated weighting 是噪声而非信号。
